physiology:
The solar plexus is where this code lives, the wide soft drum behind the lower ribs, with the small clutch of nerves the body keeps just behind it. Weather arrives here first. A held breath, a tightening, a sudden warmth, a sinking. Long before you had a word for the mood you were in, this stretch of you had already received it. The body is a listening instrument, and this is the receiving surface. Every feeling that touches a life passes across it and leaves a faint trace.

Dishonour has its floor here. The reach to hand a feeling to someone else, to make the room responsible for what is moving in you, registers as a fast clench just under the sternum, a knot that wants offloaded. Repressed, it sits and sours behind a composed face. Reactive, it fires sharp at whoever is nearest. Either way the plexus carries it, and either way the strings of the instrument go out of tune.

The climb is bodily too, and quieter than the climb of any other code. It begins when a feeling lands and the centre is permitted to stay soft. Not pushed down, not flung out. Just allowed across the surface that was made to feel it. The breath finds its own depth again. The knot loosens without being untied. Graciousness, when it first arrives, is felt here as warmth returning to a place that had been holding a long time.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to proline. Proline is the odd one in the alphabet of twenty. Its side chain loops back and ties into its own backbone, making it the only one that closes a ring inside itself. That small ring is what puts the bend into collagen, and collagen is what holds the body in its shape, the soft framework under the skin, the tendons, the linings of the vessels, the floor of every organ.

There is a teaching in that, quiet and exact. The code that carries grace through suffering is built on the molecule that bends. Not the one that stiffens, not the one that snaps clean. The one that turns back on itself and makes a curve the body can move through. Without proline the structure would lock. With it, the tissue keeps its give, and the whole listening surface stays soft enough to keep feeling.
